message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to the incoming data; data is simply moved to device and used directly.
No detected untrusted source handling: No remote data fetching is visible in this code; all data appears to be loaded locally with no checksum verification or source authentication.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is present anywhere in the data-flow path shown.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads and saves networks (trainer.save_network(), trainer.build_network()) but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision applied to any pretrained weights or serialized model files.
No detected label distribution validation: No label distribution check, class balance validation, or anomalous sample detection is performed before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: The training loop contains no backdoor defenses such as trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) or related mechanism is used anywhere in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or FGSM/PGD attack routines are imported or called anywhere in the evaluation path.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolation guarantee, hashing/signing of evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against manipulation; the same dataloader infrastructure is shared between train and test epochs.
No detected input sanitization: The demo/inference path calls trainer.demo(opt.demo_input_path) directly with no visible input shape, range, or schema validation before passing data to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: No code in the visible inference path checks model outputs for NaN values, out-of-range probabilities, or any other sanity bounds before returning results.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a 3D point cloud reconstruction model (AtlasNet), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
